Title: Why Your Eyelid Won't Stop Twitching (3 Common Triggers)

Description:
Still twitching hours after your last cup of coffee wore off? It might not be random - a few things in your cup could be overexciting the nerve that runs your eyelid.

Coffee, energy drinks, and alcohol are three of the most common triggers, and each one also drains the magnesium your nerves need to calm back down.

Watch to find out why, and simple swaps that help.
